title: Add embedder policy to the policy container

labels.name: topic: cross-origin-embedder-policy
labels.description: Issues and ideas around the new "require CORP for subresource requests and frames and etc" proposal

body: This change moves embedder policy into the policy container. The change is mostly an editorial refactoring. But it does change how embedder policy is inherited, since it now follow the logic of the policy container. In particular, with this change it is inherited from the initiator when navigating. I am not sure we have decided yet how embedder policy should behave exactly w.r.t. inheritance. However, I believe this change improves the status quo, and we can still fix inheritance for embedder policy after this change. I believe at the moment at least some inheritance cases are missing (if I understand the spec correctly, local-scheme subframes do not inherit COEP after navigation, and in particular are blocked by the COEP check - meaning that an iframe with `COEP: require-corp` cannot embed local scheme subframes other than empty ones, which is certainly something we do not want). At least those cases get fixed by this change. - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chrome * Firefox - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * Test for inheritance into child frames already exist: [blob](https://wpt.fyi/results/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/blob.https.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned), [data](https://wpt.fyi/results/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/data.https.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned), [srcdoc](https://wpt.fyi/results/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/srcdoc.https.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned), [about:blank](https://wpt.fyi/results/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy/require-corp-about-blank.https.html?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) and more in the folder [html/cross-origin-embedder-policy](https://wpt.fyi/results/html/cross-origin-embedder-policy?label=experimental&label=master&aligned) * I created some additional tests for inheritance to [workers](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/29476) and [popups](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/29475). - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed (same as for the policy container): * Chrome: [1130587: Prototype policy container](https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1130587) * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1706026 * Safari: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=224745 *** /browsers.html ( diff ) /browsing-the-web.html ( diff ) /dom.html ( diff ) /origin.html ( diff ) /webappapis.html ( diff ) /window-object.html ( diff ) /workers.html ( diff ) /worklets.html ( diff )
